title: उत्तरपर्व · अध्याय ५१

items.text:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अन्यामपि प्रवक्ष्यामि शोभनां शुभसप्तमीम् ॥
यामुपोष्य नरो रोगाच्छोकदुःखात्प्रमुच्यते ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
anyāmapi pravakṣyāmi śobhanāṃ śubhasaptamīm ||
yāmupoṣya naro rogācchokaduḥkhātpramucyate || 1 ||

items.text:
पुण्य आश्वयुजे मासि कृतस्नानः पयः शुचिः ॥
वाचयेत ततो विप्रानारभेच्छुभसप्तमीम् ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
puṇya āśvayuje māsi kṛtasnānaḥ payaḥ śuciḥ ||
vācayeta tato viprānārabhecchubhasaptamīm || 2 ||

items.text:
त्वामहं शुभकल्याणशरीरां सर्वसिद्धये ॥
अथाहृत्य तिलप्रस्थं ताम्रपात्रेण संयुतम् ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
tvāmahaṃ śubhakalyāṇaśarīrāṃ sarvasiddhaye ||
athāhṛtya tilaprasthaṃ tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam || 4 ||

items.text:
पञ्चगव्यं च संप्राश्य स्वप्याद्भूमौ विमत्सरः ॥
ततः प्रभाते संजाते भक्त्या संतर्पयेद्द्विजान् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
pañcagavyaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādbhūmau vimatsaraḥ ||
tataḥ prabhāte saṃjāte bhaktyā saṃtarpayeddvijān || 6 ||

items.text:
अनेन विधिना दद्यान्मासिमासि सदा नरः ॥
वाससी वृषभं हैमं तद्वद्धेनोस्तु पूजनम् ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
anena vidhinā dadyānmāsimāsi sadā naraḥ ||
vāsasī vṛṣabhaṃ haimaṃ tadvaddhenostu pūjanam || 7 ||

items.text:
ताम्रपात्रं तिलप्रस्थं सौवर्णवृषसंयुतम् ॥
दद्याद्वेदविदे सर्वं विश्वात्मा प्रीयतामिति ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
tāmrapātraṃ tilaprasthaṃ sauvarṇavṛṣasaṃyutam ||
dadyādvedavide sarvaṃ viśvātmā prīyatāmiti || 9 ||

items.text:
अनेन विधिना राजन्कुर्याद्यः शुभसप्तमीम् ॥
तस्य श्रीर्विमला कीर्तिर्भ वेजन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
anena vidhinā rājankuryādyaḥ śubhasaptamīm ||
tasya śrīrvimalā kīrtirbha vejanmanijanmani || 10 ||

items.text:
अप्सरोगणगन्धर्वैः पूज्यमानः सुरालये ॥
वसेद्गणाधिपो भूत्वा यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
apsarogaṇagandharvaiḥ pūjyamānaḥ surālaye ||
vasedgaṇādhipo bhūtvā yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 11 ||

items.text:
स कल्पादवतीर्णस्तु सप्तद्वीपाधिपो भवेत्॥
ब्रह्महत्यासहस्रस्य भ्रूणहत्याशतस्य च ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
sa kalpādavatīrṇastu saptadvīpādhipo bhavet||
brahmahatyāsahasrasya bhrūṇahatyāśatasya ca || 12 ||

items.text:
इमां पठेद्यः शृणुया न्मुहूर्तं वीक्षेत संगादपि दीयमानम् ॥
सोऽप्यत्र संबाध्य विमुक्तदेहः प्राप्नोति विद्याधरनायकत्वम् ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
imāṃ paṭhedyaḥ śṛṇuyā nmuhūrtaṃ vīkṣeta saṃgādapi dīyamānam ||
so'pyatra saṃbādhya vimuktadehaḥ prāpnoti vidyādharanāyakatvam || 18 ||

en_summary: Krishna tells the Shubha ("auspicious") Saptami, by which a person is freed from illness and sorrow. In Ashvina the keeper bathes in milk, has Brahmins say blessings and worships a tawny cow with scents and garlands, with a verse greeting her as born from the Sun. He gives a measure of sesame with a copper vessel, a golden bull, cloth, garlands and jaggery, with a prayer that Aryaman be pleased, takes the five cow products and sleeps on the ground. In the morning Brahmins are fed. Every month cloths, a golden bull and the worship of a cow are given, and at the end of the year a bed with sugarcane and jaggery, pillow, vessel, seat and a sesame measure with a golden bull go to a Veda-knowing Brahmin. The fruit is spotless wealth and fame in every birth, honour among Apsaras and Gandharvas, being a leader of the Ganas until the dissolution, then lord of the seven islands. The text says it removes the sin of a thousand killings of Brahmins and a hundred killings of unborn children. Reading, hearing or seeing it given frees one from the body and gives rank among the Vidyadharas.
